DICE-BENCH is a benchmark that tests how well large language models can call external functions in realistic group-chat… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/OfficerChul/DICE-BENCH.
reputation: Recently released benchmark focused on evaluating LLM tool-use in realistic multi-party dialogues; gaining interest but not yet widely adopted.
